post.summary: Initiate secure payment-first group reservation checkout
post.description: Validates availability, creates an active BookingHold and pending payment (or completes immediately via full wallet payment), and returns gateway payment URL. get.summary: List public active and approved gaming centers
get.description: Returns sanitized public details for active, APPROVED gaming centers. Supports batch fetch via `ids` (max 50) as well as combined filtering by city, province, neighborhood/district, game, hardware deviceType/alias, amenities, price range, rating, open_now status, geo-distance, sorting, and search query. Exposed at both `/api/public/gamecenters` and `/api/v1/public/gamecenters`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated gaming center IDs (max 50) for batch lookup preserving order

parameters.name: deviceType
parameters.description: Hardware platform (`PC`, `PLAYSTATION 4`, `PLAYSTATION 5`, `XBOX`, `SWITCH`, `VR`, or search aliases like `PS5`)

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: Filter centers running the specified game via catalog/center/station links (bilingual & alias aware)

parameters.name: minPrice
parameters.description: Minimum effective hourly station price (after active discounts)

parameters.name: maxPrice
parameters.description: Maximum effective hourly station price (after active discounts)

200.description: Paginated list of public active & approved gaming centers

get.summary: Get Bayesian rankings of active and approved gaming centers
get.description: Calculates Bayesian Average `(v / (v + m)) * R + (m / (v + m)) * C` across valid `PUBLISHED` reviews linked to `COMPLETED` reservations, separating eligible ranked centers from `newlyRegistered` centers.

200.description: Bayesian ranked and newly registered gaming centers with methodology

get.summary: Get single public active and approved gaming center by ID or slug

get.summary: Unified multi-criteria search across gaming centers, games, hardware, availability, and geo-location
get.description: Searches active, APPROVED gaming centers by bilingual Persian/Arabic/English text, catalog games/aliases (via real catalog/center/station links), hardware device types/aliases, amenities, effective discounted station prices, real Bayesian/average ratings, schedule/closure-aware open status, batched slot availability windows, and Haversine radius distance. Also returns dynamic facets and zero-result recovery suggestions. Exposed at both `/api/public/search/gamecenters` and `/api/v1/public/search/gamecenters`.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Unified Persian/English search query (matches centers, locations, or catalog games & aliases)

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Window start time formatted as HH:mm

200.description: Unified search results with matched games, station support, availability summary, facets, and suggestions
